notes.title: HALLOWEEN EVENT!
notes.content:
Dear Tangent Rush Community,

Today we published our first In-game event!
For a limited period of time, you can unlock the exclusive Halloween skins!

Furthermore, we added:

Halloween theme
skin system (Including 6 new skins!)
improved collision checking
bug fixes


Thank you for playing Tangent Rush!

Hear u soon :)
JOIS Games

notes.title: 1.1.0 UPDATE
notes.content:
Dear Tangent Rush Community,

we are happy to announce the biggest Tangent Rush Update so far!
This includes:

10 additional levels
New tutorials
Performance improvements
bug fixes
Version numbers
Easy bug reports
And many minor gameplay improvements!

notes.title: Content update #2
notes.content:
Dear Tangent Rush Community,

today, we published our second maintenance update!
This includes the following:

New overview screen
Stats
New settings "Set origin" and "release origin" available
Improved performance


As well as small fixes to improve player's experience!

Hear u soon :)
JOIS Games

notes.title: Content Update #1
notes.content:
Dear Tangent Rush Community,

today, we published our first update!
This includes the following:

New settings "Fullscreen" and "Resolution" available!
New tutorial videos in level 2 and 6
Faster leaderboard loading time and improved usability. Player's leaderboard rank will always show up, even when not in top 10.


As well as small fixes to improve player's experience!

Hear u soon :)
JOIS Games
